results.question: Tell me about EGSPEC
results.answer: E. G. S. Pillay Engineering College (EGSPEC) is an autonomous engineering institution in Nagapattinam established in 1995 by the G. S. Pillay & Sons Charitable and Educational Trust. It is affiliated with Anna University, recognized by the UGC under Sections 2(f) and 12(B), and accredited with NAAC A++. The official history records 11 undergraduate and 9 postgraduate programs, with recognized research centres in Mechanical Engineering, EEE, ECE, CSE, and Civil Engineering.

results.question: Give engineering placement highest package, placement percentage, recruiters and offers
results.answer:
Placement rate: The official EGSPEC homepage reports 95.8% of students placed.
Highest package: ₹60 LPA.
High-value offers: 172 students placed above ₹10 LPA.
Total offers: 1,400+.
Recruiter reach: Placements across 250+ global organizations.
Regular recruiters named on official department pages: TCS, Wipro, Amazon, Tech Mahindra, Zoho, Cognizant, Accenture, Inforview and other product, service and core-industry employers.
Lowest and average package: A verified college-wide figure is not published in the currently indexed official pages, so it should not be guessed.
Note: These are institution-published placement highlights; outcomes and salary vary by batch, branch, employer and student performance.

results.answer:
TNEA code: 3806.
Joining through counselling: Register for Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions, complete certificate verification, receive your rank, enter EGSPEC code 3806 and preferred branches during choice filling, and complete reporting after allotment.
Courses covered: TNEA is the single-window route for Tamil Nadu B.E. and B.Tech admissions.
Cutoff: There is no single fixed minimum or maximum cutoff for EGSPEC. Closing cutoffs change every year by branch, community category, counselling round and seat availability.
Branch chance: A realistic branch estimate requires your cutoff mark, community, preferred branch and admission year. The currently indexed official college page explains TNEA but does not publish a verified branch-wise closing-cutoff table, so an exact chance should not be invented.
Other routes: The college also publishes separate admission procedures for postgraduate and lateral-entry applicants.

results.question: What courses are in EGS Pillay Arts and Science College?
results.answer: The official EGSPASC course list includes UG programs: B.Com, B.Com Computer Applications, B.Com Business Process Service, B.B.A., B.A. Defence and Strategic Studies, B.Sc Computer Science, B.Sc Computer Science (Cognitive Systems), B.C.A., B.Sc Information Technology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Nutrition & Dietetics, Visual Communication, Fashion Technology and Costume Designing, Hospital Administration, B.A. Tamil, and B.A. English. The official programmes page also lists newer UG offerings including B.Com Professional Accounting, B.Sc Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Science, and Microbiology. PG programs include M.Sc Chemistry, Computer Science, Information Technology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Food Science and Nutrition, Physics, Mathematics, M.Com, M.A. English, and MBA. Research programs listed are Ph.D. Commerce, Management, Biochemistry, Computer Science, Biotechnology, English, and Physics.

results.question: List Polytechnic diploma branches
results.answer: The official Polytechnic site lists 3-year Diploma programs. Government-aided courses include Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering, and Instrumentation and Control Engineering. Self-financing courses include Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Mechanical Engineering. First-year Basic Engineering is common, followed by the allotted branch across six semesters. The college was established in 2006, is affiliated to DOTE Tamil Nadu, and highlights workshops, laboratories, placement support, and lateral-entry options to B.E.

results.question: After 10th can I join Polytechnic and what duration documents and percentage are needed?
results.answer:
EGS Pillay Polytechnic's official admission page states:
- Regular diploma: pass 10th/SSLC with at least 35%; normal duration 3 years and maximum completion period 6 years.
- Lateral entry: eligible 10+2 candidates with the listed academic/vocational subjects, or 10th plus a two-year ITI; normal duration 2 years and maximum completion period 5 years.
- Original documents listed for admission: SSLC mark sheet, HSC mark sheet for lateral entry, Transfer Certificate, recent Community Certificate, sports certificate when claiming sports quota, and three passport-size photographs.
- Reservations follow Tamil Nadu Government rules.
- Admission contact: 04365 252112.

Applicants should confirm the current-year branch availability and eligibility before applying.
